architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Shared UI in src/components/. Routes via React Router. State: Zustand. Styling: Tailwind CSS. Auth: JWT. API: REST. No SSR. Ponytail: static build, add Next.js if SEO needed.

tickets.title: Create landing page (src/pages/LandingPage.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch jastip_landing_page to React. Keep neubrutalist aesthetic. Static content only. No API calls. Responsive: mobile, tablet, desktop.
acceptance_criteria: Tailwind classes only, no custom CSS
All links stubbed, log to console

tickets.title: Build auth screens (src/pages/Auth.jsx)
tickets.description: Single Auth.jsx page. Tabs: login, register, admin login. Form validation: email format, password min 8 chars. Submit: POST /api/auth/login. Store JWT in httpOnly cookie. Redirect: /dashboard on success.
acceptance_criteria: Loading state: disable submit button, show spinner

tickets.title: Customer dashboard (src/pages/CustomerDashboard.jsx)
tickets.description: Dashboard with order stats, quick actions, event calendar. Fetch data: GET /api/dashboard. Calendar: react-big-calendar. Ponytail: static mock data, replace with API call in TASK-007.
acceptance_criteria: Calendar events clickable, log event ID
Quick action buttons stubbed, log action type

tickets.title: Product catalog (src/pages/ProductCatalog.jsx)
tickets.description: Grid view. Filter: category, price range. Sort: price, popularity. Infinite scroll. Add to cart: POST /api/cart. Ponytail: static mock data, replace with API call in TASK-007.
acceptance_criteria: Add to cart button disabled if out of stock

tickets.title: Shopping cart (src/pages/ShoppingCart.jsx)
tickets.description: Cart items list. Update quantity: PATCH /api/cart. Remove item: DELETE /api/cart. Checkout button: redirect to /checkout. Ponytail: static mock data, replace with API call in TASK-007.
acceptance_criteria: Checkout button disabled if cart empty

tickets.title: Checkout flow (src/pages/Checkout.jsx, src/pages/PaymentReceipt.jsx)
tickets.description: Multi-step form: shipping, payment, review. Submit: POST /api/orders. Upload receipt: POST /api/payments/upload. Ponytail: static mock data, replace with API call in TASK-007.
acceptance_criteria: Form validation: required fields, email format
Order summary updates on step change
Success page shows order ID, redirect to /orders after 5s

tickets.title: API integration layer (src/api/)
tickets.description: Axios instance. Base URL: /api. Headers: Authorization: Bearer <JWT>. Error handling: 401 → redirect to /auth, 400-500 → show toast. Ponytail: mock responses for TASK-001 to TASK-006, replace with real API calls.
acceptance_criteria: 401 errors clear JWT cookie, redirect to /auth

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: React Router v6. Layout: sidebar (desktop), bottom nav (mobile). Routes: /, /auth, /dashboard, /catalog, /cart, /checkout, /orders, /admin. 404 page. Ponytail: static routes, add lazy loading if bundle > 200KB.
acceptance_criteria: Protected routes: redirect to /auth if no JWT
